phase.title: Exact Scope and Provenance Freeze + Neutral Reconnaissance + Risk Grade

required: Current phase/revision and authorized reviewer lineage
Sealed Phase 0 report and automatic advancement authorization
Exact Source Intelligence core/bundle/overlay templates, schemas, and protocol from shared/source-intelligence/
conditional: Triggered domain ledgers/resources explicitly referenced by active steps
Live deployment/release/fork/remediation artifacts only when the phase card trigger applies

steps.action: Confirm authorization and exact source fence
steps.instruction: Operate only on the controller-bound Phase 1 revision/source. Do not consume later-phase conclusions.
Identify actors, assets, interfaces, exclusions, documented intent and source boundaries.
Establish the exact compiler/build/toolchain identity and accepted compiler artifacts for the frozen source before Source Intelligence generation.

steps.action: Fill the canonical Source Intelligence core from the supplied template
steps.instruction: Copy shared/source-intelligence/SOURCE_INTELLIGENCE_TEMPLATE.json into campaign evidence and populate structural source/build facts, the security-surface inventory, static upgrade/dependency/cross-chain/offchain topology, and preliminary compiler gas estimates from the exact admitted build. Do not invent a new report structure or make later-phase semantic/adequacy/runtime acceptance decisions.

steps.action: Run neutral Slither/static reconnaissance and attach it to Source Intelligence
steps.instruction: Run neutral Slither/static reconnaissance on the same admitted project and attach exact version/status/raw evidence/candidate index plus SBOM references to Source Intelligence without treating analyzer output as findings.

steps.action: Initialize overlays and pin the accepted bundle index
steps.instruction: Copy/fill the supplied runtime/deployment overlay and assurance-readiness overlay templates with Phase-1 discovery states only. Validate and commit each initial overlay revision, then copy/fill/commit the bundle index with every accepted revision, commit SHA, SHA-256, status, invalidation state, and preserved snapshot reference. Mutable paths are navigation only; Phase 1 cannot accept Phase-6A adequacy or Phase-7 runtime/gas evidence.

Use the Source Intelligence external-interface/dependency touchpoint inventory as structural baseline, then freeze dependency identities, trust assumptions and evidence needed later. Do not recreate the same structural touchpoint inventory.
Determine standards applicability and conformance requirements using the accepted interface/function inventory as baseline evidence.
Reconcile every in-scope file/contract, exclusion, compiler/config identity, dependency identity, deployable inventory, neutral reconnaissance status, and Source Intelligence artifact/digest.
After the Phase-1 structural evidence package is complete, enter the isolated scope/specification lens only for evidence-based risk grading.

steps.action: Set and seal the evidence-based security risk grade
steps.instruction: Grade assets, authority, accounting, dependencies, credible loss and promotion triggers from the exact Phase-1 evidence. Complete and seal the Phase 1 Security Risk Grade Manifest.

Update the canonical Security Traceability Graph for this phase, enumerate and reconcile every obligation due now, add stable OBL-* records for later work, and freeze current graph/ledger digests. Classify material changes under the Evidence Invalidation Matrix.

steps.action: File the Phase 1 report and trigger the successor boundary
steps.instruction: Seal the Source Intelligence package, audit-surface manifest, risk-grade manifest and global checkpoints; file the immutable Phase Report, enter AUTO_ADVANCE_READY, and immediately build the P1_TO_P2 successor package.

steps.action: Create the P1_TO_P2 successor package automatically
steps.instruction: Create campaign-local handoffs/P1_TO_P2/SUCCESSOR_HANDOFF.json, START_HERE_SUCCESSOR.md and WAKE_UP_MESSAGE.md for fresh reviewer-2; enter WAITING_FOR_SUCCESSOR_AGENT and stop. reviewer-1 must not execute Phase 2.

requiredOutputs.role: CAMPAIGN_LOCAL_CANONICAL_SOURCE_INTELLIGENCE_TEMPLATE; filled exact-structure campaign copy + digest required
CAMPAIGN_LOCAL_MUTABLE_RUNTIME_DEPLOYMENT_OVERLAY_TEMPLATE; validated accepted revision + commit + digest required
CAMPAIGN_LOCAL_MUTABLE_ASSURANCE_READINESS_OVERLAY_TEMPLATE; structural initialization only + validated accepted revision required

phaseRequirement: Add SCOPE-* and material DEP-* nodes; connect them to SOURCE-* and frozen audit surface.

sealingCriteria: All mandatory phase-card steps completed or have a permitted typed terminal limitation/failure disposition.
Phase-specific structured filing is complete, exact-source-bound, durable, and digest-referenced.

Canonical Source Intelligence core is filled from the supplied exact template, contains no __FILL_REQUIRED__ sentinel, is bound to exact source/build identity, includes Phase-1-owned structural security surfaces/topology and preliminary-not-accepted gas estimates, and has neutral Slither/static-recon evidence attached or explicitly typed-limited.
Runtime/deployment and assurance-readiness overlays are initialized from supplied templates using Phase-1 discovery states only; Phase-6A adequacy and Phase-7 runtime/gas acceptance remain pending.

Every core/overlay pointer in the Source Intelligence Bundle Index identifies an accepted revision, immutable commit, SHA-256, status, invalidation state, last verifier, and preserved snapshot; the committed index identity is recorded externally.
The Phase 1 Security Risk Grade Manifest is complete, exact-source-bound and sealed with assets, authority, accounting, dependencies, credible loss, assumptions and promotion triggers.
Security Traceability Graph is updated for this phase and its current campaign-local digest/reference is recorded.
All obligations due in this phase are reconciled in the canonical obligation ledger; no due OPEN/IN_PROGRESS obligation remains.
Every new later-phase obligation has a stable OBL-* ID and objective completion condition.
Phase Report references phase-specific artifact, traceability graph checkpoint, obligation ledger checkpoint, evidence, limitations, and invalidation triggers.
Required process failures have exhausted repair/retry/recovery or are repaired and verified; silent omission is forbidden.
Every material observed change event is classified under EVIDENCE_INVALIDATION_MATRIX; INVALIDATES/REQUIRES_REBIND work is replaced, reconciled, or carried as a typed OBL-* before sealing.
The Phase Report is filed and the P1_TO_P2 successor handoff/start/wake-up package is sealed for fresh reviewer-2; reviewer-1 enters WAITING_FOR_SUCCESSOR_AGENT and does not execute Phase 2.
